You can go to the highest level, you can go to the lowest level, wherever you go, you can find the entire infinity of God's essence there, even in the smallest thing, and even if you look at the biggest, most awesome totality of everything, it still fails, it's still like a tiny nothing if you look at it a different perspective. So that's the end of chapter ח, and yeah, as we go through, again, we'll the idea is to keep this in mind as we learn all these details, to at every stage say, okay, now that I understand this, how do I see how this is not really changing anything, how this is still connected to God, how it's still an expression of God's essence, and then once we put enough of that together, to be able to see how we can, you know, connect all those levels and see them as a single unit.
